objective: Screen explicit address-keyed virtual K/V on already-open FIT and retrieval rows. The virtual key must select the source identity while the virtual value is a nonlinear RMS-normalized contraction of the RWKV state; no model weights, protected mechanics/causal bytes, generation, Full-Bandwidth feedback, or native benchmark bytes may be opened.

paper_binding.title: Full-bandwidth transformer
paper_binding.transfer_boundary: Full-bandwidth latent feedback renews depth for one adjacent state but does not provide multi-slot identity or donor-specific addressing; feedback is deferred until this virtual-KV identity screen and a fresh causal gate pass.
paper_binding.mechanism_used_here: Address-derived virtual attention keys provide selection; RWKV state-derived virtual values provide payload; virtual positions are appended after real cache retrieval and are never cached or published to shared KV.

authorization_basis.reason_for_new_family: Linear state-times-address cosine reconstruction was donor-neutral; separate attention-logit key identity from RWKV value payload to remove cosine scale blindness.

architecture.excluded_layers: all shared-KV layers and all sliding-attention layers
architecture.value_path: bias-free SiLU MLP over fixed-probe RWKV state sketch, per-head RMS-sphere normalized
architecture.key_path: address-only projection with per-KV-head RMS-sphere normalization
architecture.position_convention: virtual keys are post-RoPE/no-position tensors; cached/full equivalence and prompt-position shift are mandatory controls
architecture.runtime: ephemeral append after real cache update, before attention softmax; no cache/shared-KV mutation

execution.hardware: exactly four distinct NVIDIA A100 GPUs

stopping_rule.pass: Archive key/value adapters and identity receipts, then authorize a new mechanics protocol; do not install Full-Bandwidth recurrence yet.
stopping_rule.failure: Retire this exact virtual-key/value family without tuning batch size, thresholds, gains, or protected-split access; choose the next independently specified hybrid.
stopping_rule.always: No causal endpoint, generation, native benchmark, Full-Bandwidth gain, or SOTA claim follows from this screen.

claim_policy.allowed: Only held-out open-split virtual-KV identity/mass behavior under the listed controls.
